task.title: Enforce planning roadmap materialization invariant
task.summary: Make planning compiler/gate require durable roadmap/sprint/work-unit ownership and queue/sprint reorder evidence for executable accepted decision rows.

goal.outcome: Planning cannot pass executable accepted decision work unless it is visibly materialized in roadmap/sprint/work-unit ownership and roadmap ordering is reconciled.
acceptance: Planning build/gate distinguishes executable rows from knowledge-only, no-work, already-implemented, and route-back blockers without CodeWiki-repo special cases.
Executable accepted rows/questions require task ids, sprint ids, or work-unit ids, even when blocked or ordered last.
Build-only executable deferral without roadmap ownership blocks planning gate pass.
Planning output records roadmap/queue/sprint-wave reorder rationale after consuming an accepted decision build.
TASK-specific tests cover missing materialization block, blocked-but-roadmap-owned pass, knowledge-only/no-work pass, and reorder evidence requirement.
non_goals: Do not make the decision loop create roadmap tasks.
Do not implement source-structure file moves.
Do not add dogfood/self-hosting project special cases.

delta.desired: Planning gate requires durable roadmap/sprint/work-unit materialization and reorder evidence for executable accepted work.
delta.current: Planning can represent executable accepted work as build-only deferral or prose-like coverage, and ordering evidence is not required for every accepted decision build.
delta.closure: Closed when generic tests prove executable accepted rows cannot disappear into build-only deferral.
